routes.laboratory: University of Naples Federico II, Department of Molecular Medicine and Medical Biotechnology

mapping_evidence.mapping_claim: The ten PRIDE LF1-L through LF5-S result units are described as five formulations extruded through 200 nm (L) or 100 nm (S) filters.

non_admission_reasons: The verified material/size mapping is governed by CC BY-NC 3.0 and must not enter the public CC0 cohort or public source bundle.
The route represents one laboratory and does not establish an identically processed endpoint with an independent laboratory.
The author-specific spectral-count and NSAF quantities are not a frozen shared cross-study endpoint.

routes.laboratory: University of Groningen, Groningen Research Institute of Pharmacy

mapping_evidence.mapping_claim: The project protocol states that formulations differ by lipid molar ratios but directs the exact compositions to a supplementary table rather than providing a numeric result-file-to-condition map in the CC0 deposit.

non_admission_reasons: No CC0 source maps every result unit to the exact numeric lipid composition or size covariate.
DOPC, DOPCG, DOPG and replicate tokens are source labels, not authorised predictive features.
The author-specific semi-quantitative protein results are not a frozen shared cross-study endpoint.

routes.laboratory: University of Helsinki, Drug Research Program

mapping_evidence.mapping_claim: The official article lists four XLSX supplements, including replicate biophysical calculations and protein-result tables; the supporting PDF states that raw proteomics or MaxQuant outputs are available only on reasonable request.

non_admission_reasons: The publisher protects direct automated supplement access with Cloudflare verification; no bypass was attempted and no workbook schema or file checksum has been verified.
The supporting information reserves raw proteomics or MaxQuant outputs for reasonable-request access, so public source-level endpoint availability is not established.
No shared source-level endpoint or frozen cross-study unit manifest is available.
